## Install / 安裝 / 安装 / インストール

**macOS 14+** (Apple Silicon & Intel)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoefix/agent-speed/main/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows 10 / 11** (x64 & ARM64, PowerShell)

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoefix/agent-speed/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Run the same command again to update. Every download is verified against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Agent Speed {{VERSION}} reads local logs from 18 supported agent sources. Conversation content is never uploaded. Live reporting and profile sharing are optional; Settings → About → Network Access controls all network features.
